question: Does Platinum grant a USD 10 free credit to every new account, and what exactly does sign-up require?
why: A search snippet of the vendor homepage says '$10 free credit', but the homepage HTML read on 2026-11-25 does not carry that phrase and the billing docs say a new org starts at USD 0 with credit added before a sandbox can be created; the dashboard signup is behind a login wall and no account was created (AGENTS.md rule 13). The free-credit amount and any card or email requirement at signup are therefore unverified; rids compute/platinum.
